steps.title: Welcome!
steps.purpose: Greet the child and set emotional tone
steps.owlText: Hello friend! Today we are going to have fun making patterns using fractions! We will use halves and quarters to make beautiful patterns. Ready?
steps.studentText: Today we make patterns using fractions! We use halves (1/2) and quarters (1/4).

media.altText: Owl teacher waving hello with a pattern of shaded shapes: half, quarter, half, quarter
media.fallbackText: Owl teacher waving hello with a pattern of shaded shapes: half, quarter, half, quarter

steps.title: Our Mission
steps.purpose: Tell the child what they will learn
steps.studentText: Today you will learn to make patterns using halves (1/2) and quarters (1/4). A pattern is something that repeats in a regular way!

steps.title: Think First!
steps.owlText: Before we start, think about this: You know patterns like: big, small, big, small... Today we will make patterns with fractions! What do you think a fraction pattern might look like?
steps.studentText: What do you think a pattern using fractions might look like? Think about it!

media.altText: A simple pattern: big, small, big, small... with a question mark for the next item
media.fallbackText: A simple pattern: big, small, big, small... with a question mark for the next item

interaction.question: Can you think of a pattern using shapes or numbers? What comes next: circle, square, circle, square, ...?

steps.title: Learn It
steps.owlText: Look at this pattern: a shape with one half shaded, then a shape with one quarter shaded, then one half, then one quarter. It repeats! The pattern is: half, quarter, half, quarter. Can you see what comes next?
steps.studentText: A fraction pattern repeats the same fractions in order. Example: half, quarter, half, quarter... The pattern repeats every two shapes. One part is always half shaded, the next is always quarter shaded.

media.altText: A sequence of 6 shapes: half-shaded, quarter-shaded, half-shaded, quarter-shaded, half-shaded, quarter-shaded. Arrows show the repeating pattern.
media.caption: Pattern: half, quarter, half, quarter...
media.fallbackText: A sequence of 6 shapes: half-shaded, quarter-shaded, half-shaded, quarter-shaded, half-shaded, quarter-shaded. Arrows show the repeating pattern.

steps.title: Real Life Connection
steps.purpose: Connect fraction patterns to real life
steps.owlText: We see patterns everywhere! When you fold paper: fold in half, fold in quarters, fold in half, fold in quarters. When you share food: half a chapati, quarter of a cake, half a chapati, quarter of a cake. These are fraction patterns in real life!
steps.studentText: Fraction patterns are everywhere! Folding paper, sharing food, arranging shapes — all can make fraction patterns.

media.altText: Real-life pattern: half chapati, quarter cake, half chapati, quarter cake.
media.fallbackText: Real-life pattern: half chapati, quarter cake, half chapati, quarter cake.

steps.title: Watch and Learn
steps.purpose: Show a worked example of continuing a fraction pattern
steps.owlText: Let me show you. Here is a pattern: half, quarter, half, quarter, half... What comes next? The pattern is: half, quarter, repeating. After half comes quarter! So the next shape should show one quarter shaded.
steps.studentText: To continue a fraction pattern: Look at the order. What comes next in the repeating sequence? Draw the next shape with the correct fraction shaded.

media.altText: Pattern sequence: half, quarter, half, quarter, half, [question mark]. Arrow points to blank space for the answer.
media.fallbackText: Pattern sequence: half, quarter, half, quarter, half, [question mark]. Arrow points to blank space for the answer.

steps.title: Your Turn!
steps.owlText: Now it is your turn! Look at this pattern: half, quarter, half, quarter... What comes next? Tap the correct shape.
steps.studentText: What comes next in this pattern: half, quarter, half, quarter, ...?

media.altText: Pattern: half-shaded, quarter-shaded, half-shaded, quarter-shaded, [blank]. Below: 4 shape options to choose from.
media.fallbackText: Pattern: half-shaded, quarter-shaded, half-shaded, quarter-shaded, [blank]. Below: 4 shape options to choose from.

interaction.question: What comes next in the pattern: half, quarter, half, quarter, ...?
options: A shape showing one half (1/2) shaded
A shape showing one quarter (1/4) shaded
A shape showing one whole shaded
interaction.correctAnswer: A shape showing one half (1/2) shaded
interaction.feedbackCorrect: Yes! The pattern is half, quarter, half, quarter, half... The next one is one half!
interaction.feedbackIncorrect: Look at the pattern: half, quarter, half, quarter... It keeps repeating. What comes after quarter in the pattern? It is half!

steps.title: Quick Check!
steps.owlText: Quick check! Look at this pattern: quarter, half, quarter, half, quarter... What comes next?
steps.studentText: What comes next in this pattern: quarter, half, quarter, half, quarter...?

media.altText: Pattern sequence: quarter-shaded, half-shaded, quarter-shaded, half-shaded, quarter-shaded, [question mark].
media.fallbackText: Pattern sequence: quarter-shaded, half-shaded, quarter-shaded, half-shaded, quarter-shaded, [question mark].

interaction.question: What comes next in the pattern: quarter, half, quarter, half, quarter...?
interaction.feedbackCorrect: Yes! The pattern is quarter, half, quarter, half... After quarter comes half!
interaction.feedbackIncorrect: The pattern repeats: quarter, half, quarter, half... After quarter comes one half.

steps.title: Think About Your Learning
steps.owlText: You did great today! Think about what you learned. What is a pattern? How can you make a pattern using fractions?
steps.studentText: What did you learn about fraction patterns today?

interaction.question: How do you feel about fraction patterns today?

steps.title: You Did It!
steps.owlText: Wonderful! You learned to make patterns with fractions today. A pattern repeats in order. You can make patterns with halves and quarters. Keep creating!
steps.studentText: You learned about fraction patterns! A pattern repeats: half, quarter, half, quarter...

media.altText: Celebration with stars and a badge that says 'I know fraction patterns!'
media.fallbackText: Celebration with stars and a badge that says 'I know fraction patterns!'
